masker.contract: Replay the three current SAM masks exactly, lift them through depth/pose, project visible support into the selected action view, then use each transported rectangle as one native SAM2 prompt.

evaluation.truth_role: Select and transport all three hypotheses before opening the action target box for scoring.

transport.ranking: Preserve the current geometry-track hypothesis order; no target, reference appearance, detector, or SAM score reranking.
transport.action_candidate: Tight rectangle of the native action-view SAM mask prompted by the depth-consistent 3D projection.

gate.requirements: At least one of the three transported action-view SAM candidates must reach IoU 0.8 with the target region, exceeding the detector-based action proposal ceiling without increasing candidate budget.

literature_motivation.name: SAMPro3D
literature_motivation.use: Uses posed RGB-D geometry to carry segmentation evidence across views and prompt SAM without task-specific training.

literature_motivation.name: MV3DIS
literature_motivation.use: Supports 3D-guided mask correspondence as an information source distinct from correlated appearance scores.

next_action: Freeze the coupled covisibility action selector plus three-hypothesis 3D prompt transport on queue row 4 before source acquisition and evaluate source-disjoint Top-3 target-region coverage.
fallback_action: Seal the consumed Development negative; do not add prompt expansion or tune transport thresholds on queue row 3.
claim_boundary: This consumed-family Development test evaluates only whether bounded current hypotheses can create action-view target-region candidates without an action-view detector. It does not confirm generalization, select the correct target identity, or establish portal access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability, or safety.
